positions.name: NoExplicitIdSlugRequirement
positions.frame: when a memory carries no explicit id field, what must the pipeline still guarantee about slug generation and commit success?
positions.why: src-1 sets the precondition — submission arrives without an explicit id — and src-2 states the required response to that condition: the pipeline must still derive a slug (via LLM id-gen or the deterministic fallback) and commit the file. Read together, one directional line runs from missing-id state to required-behavior guarantee; conviction readings support this — src-1 is a flat claim establishing the scenario, src-2 is the decision-grade operational rule answering it, and register/relational/power readings show the same technical, mandate-toned voice carrying both.
